div.font:
RLinf PPO Training (Single-Node)
- VLA policy (7B) with FSDP across 8 H200 GPUs
- GPU-accelerated simulator (ManiSkill3 or LIBERO)
- All RL components colocated in one K8s Job
- ManiSkill: split (actor 0-7, env 0-3, rollout 4-7)
- LIBERO/pi0: combined (all roles on all GPUs)
- Checkpoint + model weights on FSx for Lustre
